purpose: Catch false master-data warnings when a quotation-derived order is confirmed. Check that confirmation retains the saved price source and still reports a real master-data change.
data: One isolated synthetic MySQL fixture, with one actor, one SKU, four units of available stock, the existing setup draft, and three quotations converted to one-line orders. The third scenario renames the synthetic SKU. The reused phase2 fixture is already pinned by fulfillment-task036-event-recovery-functional.json.
concurrency: The existing server shard and worker settings apply. The scenarios execute sequentially in one test case.
repetitions: One routine execution of the new functional case per candidate through existing server discovery. Local Playwright verification remains outside CI discovery.
thresholds: Unchanged master data produces no warning or history reason when the price is carried from the quotation or entered during conversion. A genuine SKU name change produces MASTER_DATA_CHANGED and a MASTER_DIFFERENCE history reason. The saved line price and price source remain correct. Existing coverage thresholds apply.
trigger: Ordinary PR through the existing admission controller and functional server test entrypoint.
cost: The new case took 0.98 to 1.03 seconds locally including fixture setup. CI wall-clock impact and runner cost are unmeasured. It uses the existing job.

cases: UAT D-01 quotation order confirmation reports only real master changes and retains the quoted price source
